## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the remote control with circular pad on the dark brown displaystand with the left arm.

Task description: Use the left arm to place the long black remote control with a circular directional pad, on the left side of the table, on the dark brown display stand toward the front center.

Success criteria: The remote is on the dark-brown display stand surface, close to it in both left-right and front-back tabletop directions, and both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Approach the remote from above at straight middle sections of its long edges and grasp across its short dimension. Open slightly wider than the body there, avoiding raised buttons and the black obstruction near its lower-left end.
- Before closing, confirm that the pads have landed on opposite sides of the body rather than merely overlapping the remote in the image, avoiding pressing its top or pushing it away.
- Near the display stand, keep both the remote bottom and fingertips above its rim with clearance. Make small orientation adjustments in open space above it to reduce the long body sweeping the rim and pushing the stand.
- Lower the remote bottom gently onto the platform and release after confirming secure support. Leave fingertip clearance from the rim while opening and retreating to avoid moving the remote or stand.
